name: Define the task
decision: separate composition totals from location-specific change

name: Diagnose mismatches
decision: 2010 source row differs by119; coordinate-aligned windows, no resampling; hierarchical mapping

name: Analyze constraints
input: task contracts; spatial support; temporal pair
decision: proportion sufficient for full-cell area; cannot infer within-cell change locations or gross turnover from proportions alone

name: Organize alignment
decision: area branch: sum class areas then proportions; location branch: preserve native paired positions then SL event coding
output: 30x30 proportions, native classes and directional changes

name: Validate alignment
decision: grid, semantic mass, transition margins, expansion-contraction balance and raster roundtrip checked; no external truth
